vtts.releaseNotes:
Version 1.0.4 – easier listening, more natural reading, and an app half the size.

NEW
• Export a whole book as an M4B audiobook with chapters, with optional background music.
• Use your own music (MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC) as background music when listening and exporting.
• Share text, web pages from Safari, or EPUB, PDF and DOCX files to vTTS and listen right away.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: your current book, progress and a play/pause button.
• Siri shortcuts: "Continue listening", "Read text aloud", "Pause listening".
• Fix pronunciation while listening: pick a misread word in the sentence, correct it, preview and save.

EASIER LISTENING
• Skip back and forward buttons next to Play; choose 5–60 seconds in Settings, also used on the Lock Screen and headphones.
• A time-accurate seek bar that resumes at the nearest word.
• Change the voice or language while reading and continue from the same place.
• Each book remembers its own voice, language and reading speed.
• The sentence being read stands out with smooth animation and a per-sentence progress bar.
• A two-column layout in iPhone landscape, on iPad and in wide Mac windows.

MORE NATURAL READING
• Steady rhythm: the right pause at commas, sentence ends, line breaks and new sections.
• Order numbers, one-time codes, account numbers, hotlines and phone numbers are read digit by digit, in groups.
• More Vietnamese abbreviations understood: addresses, ministry names, ratios and email addresses.

FASTER AND SMALLER
• The Vietnamese voice model shrank from 326 MB to 163 MB with the same quality.
• Reading starts sooner, and very large books open much faster.

FIXES
• On iPhone, the keyboard can now be dismissed to switch tabs while typing.
• The highlight no longer jumps ahead when a line of symbols sits between sentences.
• Background music no longer makes the interface stutter.

Everything still runs entirely on your device: no internet, no account, and your text never leaves it.
vtts.description:
vTTS turns text and books into natural Vietnamese speech, right on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. The voices are built into the app, so it works completely offline: no internet, no account, and your text never leaves your device.

LISTEN TO ANYTHING
• Paste or type text and tap Play.
• Book library: add EPUB, PDF, DOCX, ODT, FB2, TXT, Markdown, RTF and HTML; books are split into chapters, show their covers and remember where you stopped.
• Share from Safari, Files or messaging apps to vTTS and listen right away.
• Recognize text in scanned PDFs.

NATURAL VIETNAMESE VOICES
• Several male and female voices, with speed from 0.5× to 1.5×.
• A natural rhythm: the right pause at commas, sentence ends, line breaks and new sections.
• Numbers, dates, times, currencies, units, percentages, phone numbers, order numbers and one-time codes read correctly.
• Common Vietnamese abbreviations understood, including academic titles, addresses and government bodies.
• English words within Vietnamese sentences, Chinese characters in Sino-Vietnamese readings and other common foreign words are handled.
• Your own pronunciation dictionary: pick a misread word while listening, correct it, preview and save.

COMFORTABLE BOOK LISTENING
• The sentence being read is highlighted and followed; tap any sentence to listen from there.
• A precise seek bar and skip back/forward buttons (5–60 seconds).
• Change the voice while listening; each book remembers its own voice and speed.
• Automatic next chapter, sleep timer, and built-in piano or your own background music.
• Lock Screen, headphone, widget and Siri controls; keeps playing with the screen off.

AUDIO EXPORT
• Save or share as M4A, MP3, AAC or WAV, with optional background music.
• Export a whole book as an M4B audiobook with chapters for Apple Books and other audiobook players.

MADE FOR EVERY DEVICE
• Layouts designed for iPhone (including landscape), iPad and Mac.
• Supports VoiceOver, larger text, Dark Mode and Reduce Motion.
• The interface is available in many languages.
• An optional local network server (off by default, protected by an access token) lets other devices on the same Wi-Fi use the voices.

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
Everything is processed on your device. vTTS collects no data, shows no ads and sends your text to no server.

Great for listening to books while driving or exercising, resting your eyes, studying, proofreading your writing, or helping anyone who finds reading a screen difficult.

padcodeai.releaseNotes:

padcodeai.description:
Pad Code AI is a powerful, local-first code editor and IDE designed specifically for iPad and iPhone. Built to deliver a desktop-class VS Code-style experience, it allows developers, students, and enthusiasts to write, run, and manage code effortlessly on the go.

Pad Code AI takes your coding experience to the next level by natively integrating Apple Intelligence. Experience the future of programming with an on-device AI assistant that helps you write better code, understand complex logic, and squash bugs—all without sending a single line of your code to external servers.

KEY FEATURES:

• Desktop-Class Editor A beautiful, highly responsive code editor with syntax highlighting for popular programming languages. Effortlessly manage multiple files with a tabbed interface and split-screen capabilities.

• Local Code Runner & Terminal Write and execute code directly on your device. Pad Code AI includes built-in local runners for languages like Python, JavaScript, Swift, C, C++, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, and Dart. Run your scripts offline, anytime, anywhere.

• Apple Intelligence Co-Pilot Harness the power of Apple’s on-device Foundation Models. Your AI assistant works directly inside the app to provide code explanations, debugging help, and suggestions—ensuring zero latency and absolute privacy.

• Git & Version Control Full Git integration allows you to clone repositories, track your file changes, commit, and securely push to GitHub using Personal Access Tokens (PAT).

• Project Workspace Create empty projects or manage existing folders effortlessly. The sidebar provides a clear, file-tree view of your workspace so you can navigate large projects seamlessly.

• Absolute Privacy (Local-First) Your code is your business. Pad Code AI operates entirely in your device's sandbox. We do not collect telemetry, crash reports, or user data. AI requests are handled on-device by Apple Intelligence.

Unlock your programming potential with Pad Code AI—the ultimate coding companion for your iPad and iPhone.

padnotesai.releaseNotes:
Thank you for using Pad Notes AI! Version 1.1.4 brings important reliability improvements, audio recovery tools, and enhanced data security:

• Audio Recording Recovery: Added a dedicated recovery manager in your library. If an audio recording is interrupted or fails to save, you can easily recover it to your notebook page or share the original audio file.
• Interruption Resilience: Enhanced audio recording engine to gracefully handle interruptions, preserving your recordings up to the exact moment of disruption.
• Robust Storage & Safeguards: Enhanced database resilience to protect your notes and drawings under low storage or system interruptions, providing clear recovery options without data loss.
• Secure API Key Storage: Upgraded Gemini API key management to securely store your keys inside the Apple Keychain with hardware-level encryption.
• Improved PDF Export: Faster, cancellable page-by-page PDF rendering with optimized memory management for large notebooks.
• Performance & Stability: Refined thread safety, smoother autosave indicators, and overall stability enhancements on macOS and iPadOS.
padnotesai.description:
Take notes the way you think — write by hand, record your voice, or type. Pad Notes AI brings together handwriting, audio, and artificial intelligence in one seamless notebook experience built for iPad and Apple Pencil.
——— HANDWRITING & DRAWING ———
Write naturally with Apple Pencil on a variety of paper styles. Pad Notes AI recognizes your handwriting automatically, making every note fully searchable without any extra effort.
——— VOICE RECORDING & TRANSCRIPTION ———
Record lectures, meetings, or ideas on the go. Your recordings are transcribed in real time, and you can tap any word in the transcript to jump straight to that moment in the audio.
——— AI ASSISTANT ———
Ask the built-in AI to summarize your notes, explain a concept, or answer questions about what you've written — all without leaving the page.
——— ORGANIZED YOUR WAY ———
Keep multiple notebooks open in tabs, browse pages as thumbnails, and find anything instantly with full-text search across handwriting, typed notes, and transcriptions.
——— EXPORT EVERYTHING ———
Share your work as a polished PDF, export audio recordings as M4A files, or save all transcriptions as a formatted text document — ready to share in seconds.
——— iCLOUD SYNC ———
Your notes stay up to date across all your devices automatically.

mynasmanager.description:
My NAS Manager is a premium, native iOS companion application designed to help you easily monitor and manage your Synology NAS (DiskStation Manager - DSM) servers from anywhere.

Built entirely using Apple's modern SwiftUI framework, the app delivers a responsive, gorgeous, and feature-rich interface to keep your private cloud running smoothly.

KEY FEATURES:

1. REAL-TIME RESOURCE UTILIZATION DASHBOARD
- Instantly monitor CPU usage and RAM allocation.
- Track real-time network upload/download speeds.
- Check storage pool health, RAID configurations, and individual drive S.M.A.R.T. diagnostics.
- View active system processes running on DSM.

2. FULL-FEATURED FILE STATION
- Seamlessly browse files and folder structures.
- Delete, rename, or create folders remotely.
- Upload files with detailed, real-time background progress bars.
- Download files to a temporary location and export them natively to iCloud Drive, local storage, or other apps.
- Generate and share public download links (gofile.me) in seconds.

3. SSH SERVICE & TERMINAL SIMULATION
- View and toggle system SSH status and change listening port numbers.
- Execute basic management commands (ls, df -h, top, uptime) using an integrated interactive terminal simulator.

4. PACKAGE CONTROL CENTER
- List installed DSM applications.
- Remotely start or stop packages such as Download Station with a single tap.

5. COMPREHENSIVE DEMO MODE
- No Synology NAS setup yet? Try our fully-featured Demo Login to experience all UI features with simulated mock data.

SECURE CONNECTIONS:
Your security is our priority. My NAS Manager supports HTTPS encryption and two-factor authentication (2FA) OTP verification codes to ensure your server credentials remain fully protected.

lunarv.description:
LunarV là ứng dụng lịch âm dương và tiện ích hàng ngày được thiết kế tối giản, tinh tế, mang lại trải nghiệm xem lịch nhanh chóng và thuận tiện nhất cho người Việt.

Các tính năng nổi bật:

Xem lịch âm dương, ngày tốt xấu, giờ hoàng đạo chính xác.
Thiết kế giao diện hiện đại, tối giản, hỗ trợ hoàn hảo chế độ Dark Mode.
Cung cấp các tiện ích (Widget) trực quan ngay trên màn hình chính.
Tra cứu và chuyển đổi ngày âm dương dễ dàng, nhanh chóng.
Bảo mật tuyệt đối: Ứng dụng hoàn toàn không thu thập dữ liệu cá nhân của người dùng.
Trải nghiệm xuyên suốt, không bị làm phiền bởi quảng cáo.

Hãy tải xuống LunarV ngay hôm nay để quản lý thời gian và theo dõi các ngày lễ truyền thống của Việt Nam một cách hiệu quả nhất!

lunarblock.releaseNotes:

• Refined menus, buttons, score panels, and settings controls
• Improved saved-run handling after completed games
• Added clearer English and Vietnamese time labels

lunarblock.description:
Lunar Block transforms the classic falling-block puzzle into a cinematic 3D orbital arena for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Stack, rotate, hold, and drop crystal blocks to complete rows and build your highest score. Master responsive controls, use the ghost piece to plan each move, and chain combos, four-line clears, back-to-back clears, and Perfect Clears.

Choose your challenge:

• Marathon: survive as long as possible
• Sprint: clear 40 lines as fast as you can
• Ultra: score as much as possible in 120 seconds

Features:

• Smooth 3D playfield with dynamic lighting and impact effects
• Seven-piece bag, hold slot, next preview, and ghost piece
• Wall kicks and responsive lock-delay controls
• Touch gestures, keyboard, on-screen controls, and game controller support
• Haptic feedback, synthesized sound effects, and optional enhanced effects
• Personal records, XP ranks, achievements, and Game Center leaderboards
• English and Vietnamese localization
• Automatic saved-run support across sessions

Play comfortably on iPhone, iPad, or Mac with controls adapted to each platform. Every drop changes the shape of your run. Stay focused, clear the board, and reach the next lunar rank.
